title: Aggregate Basics
description: Calculate total revenue, average order value, number of orders, and the highest single order for each month in 2024. Return columns: month, total_revenue, avg_order, num_orders, highest_order.
hints: Use AVG(total) for average order value
Use COUNT(*) for number of orders
Use MAX(total) for highest single order
Use EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) or DATE_TRUNC for grouping
